Officials immediately questioned the mother, who said she and her son had lived on the first floor of the house for two years. She had just celebrated his sixth birthday a week earlier. Their landlord Joseph Chuba and his wife Mary lived upstairs, though they shared the kitchen and living room space. Although she described Joseph as angry and abusive toward his wife, she said they occasionally helped each other when needed. She even recalled him greeting her once in Arabic saying, Asalam alakum, or hello, seemingly out of respect. But in the days after the then-recent Hamas attack in Israel, his behavior toward her Muslim faith changed. She claimed that four days after the attack on the other side of the planet, he told her he was afraid of her and hated Muslims for killing people. When she advised that they pray for peace, he told her to contact her realtor and move out. Three days later, Joseph knocked on her door as he had in the past when he needed help. This time, he suddenly forced his way in and confronted her about her inaction with the ongoing war. When she informed him she prayed for peace, He called her the devil and proceeded to punch and stab her, allegedly attempting to break her teeth. She was stabbed more than a dozen times, causing vision loss in one eye. Joseph left the building only after she played dead, during which time she grabbed her phone, ran to the bathroom, and closed the door behind her. When Joseph re-entered the home, he found her six-year-old son. She testified as she called 911. She heard her son screams. Joseph stabbed the boy 26 times, leaving the knife in his body before walking out the back door and sitting on the ground. During transport, Joseph told police, ever since the massacre of Israel where they killed 50 babies, I confronted her. He reportedly also referred to Muslims as infested rats. Joseph was charged with one count of first-degree murder, one count of attempted first-degree murder, one count of aggravated battery with a deadly weapon, and two counts of hate crimes, one against Muslims, and one against those with Palestinian descent. He pled not guilty to all counts. The boy's father shared his son, loved everything, he loved everybody, he loved his toys, he loved basketball, soccer, he loved to color, he loved to swing around, he loved his parents, he loved his family and his friends, He loved life. The jury deliberated for less than 90 minutes before finding Joseph guilty on all counts. Well over a year after the incident, he was sentenced to 53 years in prison. On July 24, 2025, less than three months after his sentencing, Joseph passed away. While his cause of death is not known, reports indicate he had stage 4 cancer.
